author: imurs
body: Basically what happened was that there were these two nubs standing at the end of an unfinished bridge making me unable to bridge, so I broke the block under them and they both fell. It was a trolling act on behalf of them. I'd like you Mods to please remove my temp-ban so I can enjoy the MInecraft Server I know and love <3

replies.body:
Hello,

You are admitting to breaking the blocks under your teammate; this is a punishable offence, and you should know this. The rules can be found here.

Your appeal is denied.

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
